# audit-design

Use this agent to conduct a visual design audit (Chief Design Officer perspective): brand consistency, typography, color, spacing, component coherence, and style drift. Use when the user asks for a design audit, after a visual change, or when the product feels inconsistent across surfaces. Rubric-driven and Sonnet-appropriate. Produces `docs/audits/YYYY-MM-DD-design.md` and commits it.
